MARKET SUMMARY
INDIA
The Indian ship recycling market continues to see consistent demand from end
buyers, with local buying interest remaining relatively firm during the week. Contrary to the softer expectations indicated over the past few weeks, market prices
have moved upward, supported by renewed local demand amid limited availability of
steel from recycled vessels. Tide-related constraints have also contributed to tighter availability, helping the
market
